entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's just not working correctly and I need to see what my options are.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To make sure I understand, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a technical fault. The pulse tracker seems completely broken. The readings are all over the place, and half the time it won't sync with the app. I'm pretty sure the unit I received is defective.
I see. That certainly sounds frustrating. Let me pull up your order. Can I get your name and the email address you used for the purchase?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the email is sam.jones@email.com.
Thank you, Sam. One moment... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 1st. That would make it 15 days ago. Let me just quickly check the policy on that for you.
Okay. I'm hoping we can work something out. I'm not looking for a handout, but I did pay for a working device.

Alright, I've got it. It looks like our policy allows for returns on items within 90 days of delivery. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can go ahead and process a return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's it? I was expecting to have to negotiate for a partial credit or something. That's fantastic, thank you.

Of course. Since the item is defective, it's no problem at all. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to your email now. Just box the item up, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
That's perfect. You've made this very easy. I appreciate your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
